text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing through the department store's 
event hall on my day off, a Valentine's 
fair was being held.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the live demonstrations and 
sampling the famous chocolatiers' treats, 
smiles blossomed across everyone's faces. 
Or as she would put it—
choice_data_list: (It's overflowing with marvelousness)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to share this dazzling Marvelous, 
so unique to Valentine's, with her too.
choice_data_list: One chocolate, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Valentine's. Right away in the 
morning, I ran into Marvelous Sunday on 
the tree-lined path.
choice_data_list:
Good morning! Do you remember what day it 
is today?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! Today is a marvelous day! 
Yesterday, tomorrow, and the day after 
too! Every single day is marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I missed my chance to give chocolates to 
Marvelous Sunday. Well, there'll be other 
chances, I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chin, what do you wanna eat for 
lunch~?
choice_data_list: Ah, Marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants a Tracen Club Sandwich... Huh, 
Mave-chin!? Mave-chin disappeared!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Looking for Marvelous-san? Please wait a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-san, Trainer is... Wait, huh!? 
Where are you going!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I tried to call out to Marvelous 
Sunday, for some reason, our timing was 
completely off.
choice_data_list: Ah, found you! Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday dashes off. ...Could she 
be avoiding me? Overcome with anxiety, I 
chase after the red ribbon.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh~, I'm even more nervous than 
before a race. But still, I'm definitely 
giving you this chocolate...!"

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, for me!? No way... I didn't think I'd 
get one. I'm super, super happy!
choice_data_list:
(Is this... a world conjured by 
Marvelous?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I realized this scenery was impossible in 
reality. And yet... something felt off. It 
felt somewhat different from her world.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Marvelouuus☆
choice_data_list: Found you, Marvelous Sunday!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: !! ...Ehehe☆ You found me★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer. Was the Marvelous you 
were looking for heart-pounding Marvelous? 
Or was it heart-fluttering Marvelous?
choice_data_list: It's both.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, you felt it too, Trainer! 
Everyone's heart-pounding, spark-flying 
Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So much marvelous is overflowing, painting 
everything so warmly and vividly☆ It's 
truly in full spring bloom★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's not just sweet feelings. I 
can also sense a restless, daring spirit."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"It's just like before a race! So many 
girls fighting hard☆ It's marvelous★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I want to share this Marvelous with you 
too, Trainer. That's why I decided to give 
you some Marvelous as a present!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, you kept chasing after me, Trainer! 
I had to hold back soooo much so I 
wouldn't spoil the surprise☆
choice_data_list:
So that's why you've been running around 
avoiding it...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because for something truly 
marvelous, it needs a top-notch surprise, 
right?☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, Trainer! Happy Marvelous 
Valentine☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer, open it, open it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the present from Marvelous Sunday 
right away, what came out from inside was—
choice_data_list: ...Haniwa-shaped chocolates?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It's a warrior haniwa chocolate☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's and racing are both thrilling 
battles☆ You can't talk about Earth's 
history without mentioning battle★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"And chocolate shaped like the warrior 
haniwa that symbolizes it. Perfect for 
Valentine's, right?☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her logic was a bit baffling, but it felt 
very true to her. I gratefully accepted it 
and offered her some chocolate in return.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: !! Hey, hey, does this mean—!
choice_data_list: I wanted to deliver Marvelous too.
I wanted to deliver Marvelous too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer? You feel the same way I 
do?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, our Marvelous connected! I wonder 
if it's a one-in-a-million miracle? It's 
so Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A miracle born from thinking of each other 
and doing the exact same thing. The 
chocolate they shared together tasted 
truly marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer. Was the Marvelous you 
were looking for heart-pounding Marvelous? 
Or was it heart-fluttering Marvelous?
choice_data_list: It's both, but that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she was searching for was a 
heart-thumping, heart-fluttering, 
sparkling, shining, world's greatest 
Marvelous.
choice_data_list: Marvelous Sunday, I was looking for you.

Marvelous Sunday, I've been looking for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaaa!?!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was in that familiar 
space that Marvelous Sunday always 
conjures up.
choice_data_list: This spot really feels the most Marvelous.

This spot really feels the most Marvelous, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Do I look just like normal to you, 
Trainer? You must really be feeling my 
Marvelous, then☆
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it felt like an entirely different 
world until just a moment ago.

Yeah, until just a moment ago, it felt 
like a completely different space.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, today is Valentine's Day, 
and it's just overflowing with 
marvelouuusness☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's Marvelous swept over me, and 
the whole world was dyed in everyone's 
Marvelous color.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing?! Feeling everyone's 
marvelosity fills my heart with the warm 
glow of spring! It's super marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Still... Trainer chose me.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a warm and vivid Marvelous for 
everyone, I want to show my Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufu! MARVELOUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see, I wanted to be the one to deliver 
the most marvelous surprise to you, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Me too.
Me too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I finally hand Marvelous Sunday the 
chocolate I hadn't been able to give her 
all day.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaarvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her smile, I deeply savor the joy 
of delivering marvelousness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I missed my chance 
to ask why she was running away."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I opened the door to the 
Trainer's Office.
choice_data_list: ...Why Halloween?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Marvelous mega success~☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now, trick-and-marvelous☆ I hid something 
marvelous in this room, so try to find it★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why she was running away. 
It seems Marvelous Sunday was secretly 
preparing a marvelous "unexpected 
surprise".
choice_data_list:
In that case, maybe inside this doll's 
hat...

text_block_list.name: Ghost Hat Doll
text_block_list.text:
"Marvelous! Marvelous! Time for a trick! 
Ahahahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt! Wrong answerâ
choice_data_list: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bunch of ghost dolls and bat dolls fell 
down from the ceiling!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Finding it easily wouldn't be very 
Marvelous, right? It's Valentine's Day, 
after all, so I got serious about hiding 
it! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, enjoy the full-power Marvelous to 
your heart's content☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It seems whatever is hidden here is 
extraordinarily Marvelous! Then let us 
search with all our hearts!
